entries.notes: Per script. scripts/setup-env.sh: vendored at the pinned commit, then locally edited; it diverges from the sibling in behavior, not just wording. (1) klt installs from a PyPI release pin (KLT_VERSION, kept in sync with flow/smoke/records/environment.json and bumped by its own PRs) instead of the sibling's git-ref install (klayout-tools @ git+KLT_REPO@KLT_REV; the sibling has no KLT_VERSION variable). (2) cocotb is pinned by this repo's verification/requirements.txt (cocotb==1.9.2, installed via pip -r alongside klt and ciel) instead of the sibling's bare 'cocotb' requirement (which resolves 2.0.1 through klt's own pin). (3) The step-4 toolchain check additionally probes for verilator (iverilog/verilator/openroad, with its own missing-tool guidance and Python-interpretation note) where the sibling probes iverilog/openroad only. (4) -h/--help prints the leading comment block dynamically (awk over the absolute SELF path) instead of the sibling's hard-coded 'sed -n 2,31p' line range, so the header cannot drift from the code. Comments and echo messages were also rewritten to point at this repo's files (flow/smoke/records/environment.json, scripts/openroad-docker.sh, verification/run_tests.py, verification/README.md) rather than the sibling's (docs/environment.md, verification/check_pins.py, verification/cross_check.py), and the inherited sibling issue-number citations are kept but qualified 2AMLogic/sky130-modexp#N so they resolve from this repo. scripts/openroad-docker.sh: comments and diagnostic messages only, no logic change (sibling file references -- docs/environment.md, scripts/openroad-smoke-test.sh -- replaced with local ones; the PDK-search citation qualified the same way). sha256 values are of the local edited files. openroad-docker.sh is taken because setup-env.sh symlinks it as the openroad fallback; on this host the PATH openroad wrapper does not forward PLATFORM_DIR, so the docker wrapper is the working route. The sibling's OpenROAD smoke test (a script plus fixture directory under scripts/) was first vendored here, then removed per the operator ruling on 2AMLogic/sky130-adpll#42: flow/smoke is the single toolchain proof. Not taken: scripts/spice_lef_parsing.py (unrelated), docs/environment.md and verification/check_pins.py (the sibling setup script's comments point at them; this repo records pins in flow/smoke/records/environment.json instead).

Harness shape only (cocotb DUT helpers, record checker, gate-level pattern). No file content is vendored; the runner and checker here are new and much smaller. verification/gate-level/ takes the sibling's SHAPE -- a committed sky130_fd_sc_hd_sim_defines.v listed first on the source list, plus a wrapper script -- but not its content: run-gate-level.sh is written against this repo's verification/run_tests.py rather than the sibling's `klt functional-verification` request JSON, and the defines DIVERGE on UNIT_DELAY. The sibling defines it as `#1` to work around Icarus leaving D_delayed/CLK_delayed undriven under the timing arm; measured here (2AMLogic/sky130-adpll#70, Icarus 13.0): that all-x failure does not reproduce, and `#1` instead fails test_top.py:37 on seeds 12345/777/20260114 because test_top's tick() samples 1 ns after each ref_clk edge, exactly when a #1 flop output transitions. This repo defines UNIT_DELAY empty (zero delay). Pins to be revisited with the environment pin (#3).

Merge-queue adaptation shape only, from the sibling's t1-signoff.yml at commit 38b0058 (its merge_group support commit): add a bare `merge_group:` trigger next to pull_request on every workflow a merge queue must schedule, plumb the event shas as step `env:` (EVENT / PR_BASE / PUSH_BEFORE / MG_BASE instead of `${{ }}` inside the script) so the selection is testable, and take the merge_group base from github.event.merge_group.base_sha because the checked-out ref is the trial merge. No content is vendored and the sibling is NOT file-mapped: its gate is a Python append-only checker specific to sim/ evidence, so only the trigger + base-plumbing + fail-closed-on-empty-base shape is taken, re-expressed here as a POSIX sh selector (scripts/loom-path-gate-base.sh) with its own shell selftest, guarding this repo's .loom/ path gate. The local workflows differ further from the sibling's: ci.yml also gates an allowlisted .loom/ suite set and signoff.yml has no base-dependent step at all (it only gained the trigger).
